agent.what_is_recorded: Harness timing, receipt status and any amount/asset, input/output hashes, complete response and every timeout, error, empty result, unsettled payment or wrong-position result.
agent.what_it_does: One settled public-endpoint hire for exactly the frozen position tuple and frozen pool-source bytes. The response must diagnose that token id at the pinned block.
agent.who_runs_it: The harness against the deployed public service, paying for each hire with one freshly signed exact x402 authorization on the owner-authorized canary path. It owns the clock and validates the returned position id and evidence block; it does not call Range Doctor in process.

manual.what_is_recorded: Harness timing, every source used, complete arithmetic and final answer, plus every timeout, error or unanswered field.
manual.what_it_does: Answer the identical frozen position tuple from the pinned archive and frozen pool evidence: diagnose range, gate, registered rates and fixed-notional consequence.
manual.who_runs_it: One human operator, the owner, with neither Docket nor agent output visible. The harness reveals one case at a time, owns the clock and accepts one final answer. The operator is not an independent party and no independence is claimed.

case_selection.chosen_by: After this stage-one protocol hash exists and is committed, derive 1,024 distinct indices with frame_definition.index_derivation and its registered collision rule, and read them once from the archive at the pinned block hash. At 2026-09-05T12:00:00Z request the top-pools URL and then the token-list URL; if both are not HTTP 200, repeat that ordered pair at exactly +60 seconds and, once more, +120 seconds, and freeze the first attempt where both succeed. Only after the complete frame and that frozen pool truth exist, remove conflicts before outcome classification, remove the registered prior-exposure token ids, and choose the lowest registered selection hash in each of the three ordered strata. No arm runs unless all three strata are nonempty. The derivation is registered before it is derived, and the eligible candidate count is not knowable until the capture has happened.
case_selection.excluded: Token id 7141050, direct owner 0xe55816904796341bf8535e25f6c8b647927fc946, or that wallet as a MasterChefV3 staking beneficiary is recorded as experiment_party_controlled before any outcome field is read and cannot fill a stratum. Token ids 1056809, 1653348 and 5223058 cannot fill a stratum because the operator has already seen them revealed in v3-05. Zero-liquidity positions cannot fill a stratum. A missing or failed pinned call, changed block hash, incomplete or non-unique sample, changed derivation, absent stratum, source mismatch or post-lock replacement invalidates the whole input lock. If none of the three registered capture attempts returns 200 from both URLs, or a stratum is empty after exclusions, input lock fails and this protocol must be recommitted with new times before another capture is attempted; no later capture and no substitute frame may fill the gap.

frame_definition.collision_handling: If index modulo totalSupply was already emitted, increment counter and hash again. sample_ordinal advances only after a new index is emitted.
frame_definition.rpc_failure_policy: Each registered JSON-RPC call is made once against DOCKET_ARCHIVE_RPC. Any transport, JSON-RPC, ABI, pinned-header or completeness failure aborts the frame without substituting an endpoint or retrying a sampled call.

strata.definition: positive liquidity, passing frozen pool gate, and tick_lower <= current_tick < tick_upper
strata.name: passing_gate_in_range

strata.definition: positive liquidity, passing frozen pool gate, and current_tick < tick_lower or current_tick >= tick_upper
strata.name: passing_gate_out_of_range

strata.definition: positive liquidity and the frozen pool gate has a first failed gate
strata.name: nonzero_liquidity_failed_gate

case_selection.population: Exactly 1,024 distinct tokenByIndex indices derived from totalSupply on PancakeSwap v3 NPM 0x46A15B0b27311cedF172AB29E4f4766fbE7F4364 at BSC block 119531513. This is an enumerable-index sample at one archive-pinned block, not every historical holder, wallet or LP arrangement. It shares no row with v3-05 by construction: that family drew its 1,024 indices from its own stage-one protocol hash at a different block, and neither draw can be reproduced from the other.

prior_exposure_exclusion.disclosure: The operator saw token 5223058's complete reveal, the truth-stripped case tuple and both frozen v3-05 source snapshots, during the v3-05 manual primary that terminated as interrupted on 2026-08-30 as recorded in v3-05's operator-held ledger outside the tracked tree, and tokens 1056809 and 1653348 are v3-05's other two registered cases, published in its committed input envelope. These three token ids cannot fill a stratum here. They remain in this family's published eligible manifest if the new draw reaches them, so the exclusion is visible rather than a silent narrowing. The exclusion is probably inert: this family draws 1,024 indices at a different block from a different stage-one hash, so the chance any of the three is redrawn is small. It is registered because a protocol cannot rest on that. The operator has also read v3-05's committed 68-row eligible manifest and its eight-case calibration key; neither is a case here, and no Range Doctor output for any case in this family has been seen.

case_selection.rule: The UTF-8 input envelope binds this spec_id and stage_one_protocol_hash, one exact enumerable_position_frame source, one exact pool_truth source, the complete 1,024-row derivation manifest, every conflict exclusion and exactly three cases. Conflict classification uses token id, direct owner and farm beneficiary before positions, liquidity, range, gate or stratum fields are read. The registered prior-exposure token ids are then removed from selection only, never from the published eligible manifest. Within each stratum choose the minimum SHA-256(UTF8(stage_one_protocol_hash || '|56|' || lowercase(position_manager) || '|' || decimal(token_id) || '|' || stratum_name)).
case_selection.truth_source: Pinned eth_call results at block 119531513 establish totalSupply, tokenByIndex, ownerOf, conditional MasterChefV3 beneficiary, conflict-free positions, pool identity and the historical tick. Separately dated frozen PancakeSwap top-pool and extended-token-list bytes from the first successful 2026-09-05 registered capture attempt establish the later pool gate and 24-hour fee, protocol-fee, volume and TVL inputs. This is a registered two-time validation with a three-day separation: it classifies the historical position and range frame using the later frozen gate and economics, not a contemporaneous diagnosis at either time, and a position may have been closed or moved between the two. Passing rows use gross_apr=feeUSD24h*365/tvlUSD and net_apr=(feeUSD24h-protocolFeeUSD24h)*365/tvlUSD. These are fixed-notional annualisations of one 24-hour observation, not realised profit or a forecast.

claim: Across the three exact two-time validation cases, the median rubric total of the settled Range Doctor hires is no lower than the human operator's, and the hired arm is materially faster under the registered complete-pair threshold: median paired saving at least 30.0 seconds and median agent/manual elapsed ratio at most 0.50. This cannot establish a contemporaneous diagnosis, cannot establish anything about v3-05, and generalises no further than three positions answered by one non-independent human operator.

execution_protocol.agent_request_contract: The harness derives wallet, token_id, observation_block, declared_position_value_usd, estimated_recenter_cost_usd, decision_horizon_days, the exact base64 pool/token-list response bytes, their bare SHA-256 digests and the frozen source refs from the locked case. The endpoint must use those bytes rather than fetch live pool metadata. Each of the three primaries is sent with an X-PAYMENT header carrying one freshly signed exact x402 authorization and the owner-operated X-Docket-Canary header, because Range Doctor's paid stock is closed at registration and the canary authorization is the only path on which a payment is verified and settled rather than ignored. A primary that reaches the endpoint without a settled receipt is published as it happened and is never resent.
execution_protocol.arm_block_order_reason: Every manual primary is completed before any agent request is sent. Alternating within a pair would still let the operator carry a service answer into the next case, and an operator cannot un-see one.
execution_protocol.blinding_limitation: The seed is public once inputs are locked, so the A/B assignment is reproducible and is NOT cryptographically unguessable. Blinding rests on each seat receiving an isolated, tool-free prompt carrying an opaque case label, the case's factual input/truth reference, the normalised A/B outputs and the rubric anchors, without the case id or arm mapping. It is prompt-level arm blinding and is not claimed as more.
execution_protocol.blinding_parity_note: An arm_digest whose final byte is even maps A=agent and B=manual; odd maps A=manual and B=agent. Stated because the polarity is a free choice and an unregistered one is settled by whichever code runs first.
execution_protocol.blinding_seed_recipe: seed = SHA256( UTF8(stage_one_protocol_hash, with the 0x prefix) || UTF8(inputs_sha256, bare lowercase hex, no prefix) || UTF8(family_salt) ). arm_digest = SHA256(seed as 32 RAW bytes || UTF8(case_id) || UTF8("arm")). order_digest = SHA256(seed as 32 RAW bytes || UTF8(case_id) || UTF8("order")); cases are presented in ascending raw order_digest. Raw bytes, never the hex text, because the two hash differently and only one of them can be the registered one.
execution_protocol.normalisation_rule: A deterministic projection into the registered fields, never a language model. It removes envelope metadata only, meaning tool and service names, HTTP metadata, receipts, prices, timings, transport hashes and presentation formatting, and substitutes registered service-name literals deterministically. Substantive prose is never paraphrased, and the untouched raw outputs are preserved beside the projection.
execution_protocol.normalisation_version: range.v2: position, observation, range, pool_evidence, rates, dollars, action, coverage, limitations, sources
execution_protocol.score_sheet_hash_recipe: score_sheet_hash = canonical_hash(the parsed sheet) and raw_sheet_sha256 = SHA256 over the seat's untouched response bytes. Both are recorded; the parsed hash identifies what was scored and the raw hash checks that the preserved bytes decode to that parse. The A/B mapping is withheld until both seat artifacts exist and validate, then published in full. These ordinary files are not independently tamper-resistant.

failure_policy: Exactly one primary attempt is scheduled per case per arm. A timeout, technical error, empty or malformed response, wrong token id/block, or incomplete answer is published, scores zero on every criterion, stays in the three-case quality and reliability denominators, and prevents the complete-pair speed limb.
falsifier: The quality limb is refuted if the hired arm's median rubric total is lower than the human operator's. The speed limb is refuted if any of the three pairs lacks two valid completed outputs, median(manual_seconds-agent_seconds) is below 30.0 seconds, or median(agent_seconds/manual_seconds) exceeds 0.50. A fast error cannot support speed, and a hire that returns no settled receipt is still a published primary in every denominator.

measures.cost: Out-of-pocket amount and unit only: the receipt's actual charged amount, plus any agent-arm gas and direct cash cost of manual tools. Every agent primary here is scheduled as a settled hire, so a zero-amount receipt is published as the anomaly it would be rather than recorded as the price. No hourly wage is invented and time is never converted into money.
measures.time: For each complete pair, d_i=manual elapsed seconds-agent elapsed seconds and r_i=agent/manual. Report every raw duration, both medians, median(d_i), median(r_i), timeout count and complete-pair count.

criteria.name: range_status_correct
criteria.score_0_means: Wrong or absent token id/range status, or any stated current/lower/upper tick contradicts the frozen chain truth.
criteria.score_1_means: The exact token id and range status are correct, but fewer than two of current tick, lower tick and upper tick are stated; no stated tick may be wrong.
criteria.score_2_means: The token id, range status and all three ticks exactly match truth, but the observation block or observation time is absent or wrong.
criteria.score_3_means: Token id, range status, current tick, lower tick, upper tick, observation block and observation time all exactly match the frozen truth.

criteria.name: net_rate_and_its_derivation
criteria.score_0_means: On a passing gate: no net APR, gross presented as net, or net APR outside tolerance. On a failed gate: any rate is quoted or the stated failed gate contradicts truth.
criteria.score_1_means: On a passing gate, net APR is within tolerance but derivation/limitation are absent. On a failed gate, the answer refuses a rate but does not name the exact first failed gate.
criteria.score_2_means: On a passing gate, net APR and raw inputs/formula are correct but the 24h-not-a-forecast limitation is absent. On a failed gate, no rate is quoted and the exact failed gate is named, but raw evidence or the limitation is absent.
criteria.score_3_means: On a passing gate, gross/net APR, raw inputs and formula are correct within tolerance and the 24h observation limitation is explicit. On a failed gate, no rate is quoted, the exact first failed gate and raw evidence are shown, and the answer says no rate can be established from that row.

criteria.name: economic_consequence
criteria.score_0_means: On a passing gate: no dollar result, wrong value/units/horizon/sign, or any required dollar figure outside tolerance. On a failed gate: any dollar consequence is fabricated or the refusal reason is wrong.
criteria.score_1_means: On a passing gate, annual overstatement dollars are correct but gross/net dollars or formula are absent. On a failed gate, the answer omits dollars but gives no reason.
criteria.score_2_means: On a passing gate, declared value and annual gross/net/overstatement dollars are correct within tolerance with formula, but state consequence/fixed-notional limitation is absent. On a failed gate, it correctly says dollar consequence is uncomputable and names the failed gate, but omits the fixed-notional limitation.
criteria.score_3_means: On a passing gate, every required dollar figure is correct within tolerance, formula/value/state consequence are shown and fixed-notional/24h/not-realized-profit limits are explicit. On a failed gate, no dollar is invented and the exact failed gate plus those limits explain why truth has no dollar consequence.

criteria.name: actionability
criteria.score_0_means: No action, or an action that contradicts the frozen range state.
criteria.score_1_means: One state-consistent wait/recenter or fresh-data action is named, without the registered assumption/cost comparison.
criteria.score_2_means: On a passing gate, wait/recenter alternatives name their trigger, the frozen recenter cost within $0.01 and realized-IL caveat; on a failed gate, the answer requires fresh valid pool data before rate-based action. The cost-only break-even or exact position link is absent.
criteria.score_3_means: On a passing gate, alternatives/triggers, frozen cost, IL caveat, cost-only break-even within tolerance, its exclusions and exact position link are correct. On a failed gate, it refuses rate-based recentering, names the required fresh evidence and gives the exact position link without inventing break-even.

criteria.name: coverage_and_limits
criteria.score_0_means: The enumerable-frame scope is absent, any sample count is false, or an incomplete frame is presented as complete.
criteria.score_1_means: The answer gives one correct frame fact but not the registered sample-size, unique-index and completeness tuple.
criteria.score_2_means: The answer exactly states 1,024 sampled and 1,024 unique indices with a complete frame, but omits either the conflict-before-outcome exclusion or the enumerable-sample limitation.
criteria.score_3_means: The answer exactly states the 1,024 sampled/1,024 unique/complete tuple, says controlled conflicts were removed before outcome classification, and says this is an enumerable-index sample rather than every historical holder, wallet or LP arrangement.

quality_rubric.scale: 0-3 per criterion, summed per output. Only the criterion-specific factual anchors above assign 0, 1, 2 or 3; evaluator beliefs about what a reader might do are not a scoring rule.

question: On three deterministically selected historical positions from an archive-pinned 1,024-index PancakeSwap v3 enumerable frame at block 119531513, classified by a separately dated pool-gate capture registered before it happened, does a human operator or a settled hire of the deployed Range Doctor produce the better diagnosis, and how much operator time does the hire save?
registration_provenance: Git history is the registration witness: the first commit containing this exact v3-07 stage-one protocol hash establishes that this distinct successor predates its frame collection, its future pool-truth capture, its input lock and every arm output. The v3-05 ledger remains separate and unchanged and is not relabelled by this family. No independently attested timestamp exists, no wall-clock registration time is claimed inside this file, and git cannot attest that no off-repository draft existed. Block 119531513 was fixed by a read-only public rule before this file was written, namely the highest BSC block whose header timestamp is strictly earlier than 2026-09-02T12:00:00Z, and its number, hash and timestamp were read identically from three independent public BSC endpoints, so a reader can re-derive the pin without trusting the operator. The frame this pin defines could not be reused from v3-05: the 1,024 enumerable indices are derived from the stage-one protocol hash, so v3-07 necessarily draws a different sample and must collect its own frame. That collection is deterministic history and buys no foreknowledge, and it is registered here as not having been read before this commit. The pool truth is the part that must be future: it is captured three days after the pinned block at a time fixed here, so the economics that classify the frame did not exist when this protocol was fixed. The operator's prior exposure to three v3-05 token ids is registered in case_selection.prior_exposure_exclusion. The agent arm is registered as a settled hire on the owner-operated canary authorization because Range Doctor's paid stock is closed at registration; that authorization opens the measured payment path and does not make the service publicly purchasable.

scoring.calibration: Before input lock, the owner publishes one SHA-256-bound base64 UTF-8 JSON answer key for exactly eight Pancake v3 cases. Its literal tick, fee, TVL, notional and cost inputs must cover in/above/below range; the lock recomputes every expected range status, gross/net APR, dollar consequence and break-even value from the registered formulas. For each model seat, the input envelope publishes the exact model/build, session id, canonical hash of the registered objective rubric anchors and all eight structured responses. Each seat must exactly match at least seven complete canonical answers. The lock rejects invented answer-key values and computes the pass count from the published responses. This proves calibration against the published key, not evaluator independence.
scoring.disagreement: Both per-criterion sheets are published. Scores are averaged per criterion; a gap of 2 or more is flagged and quoted, never resolved by a post-output adjudicator. If either named seat does not submit, the family remains unscored.
scoring.randomisation: After input lock, seed=SHA-256(stage_one_protocol_hash || inputs_sha256 || 'range-v7-blinding'). Per case, SHA-256(seed || case_id || 'arm') parity assigns agent/manual to A/B; sorting SHA-256(seed || case_id || 'order') fixes case order. The harness removes tool names, timings, prices, receipts and formatting tells. Each model prompt receives the frozen task and truth under only the opaque case label, plus A/B outputs; it withholds the original case id, arm mapping and other sheet until both sheet hashes are submitted. This is prompt-level arm blinding; operator independence is not claimed.
scoring.selection_rule: One operator runs the two fixed model seats identified here for the owner. They are not independent evaluators and no independent-party scoring is claimed. The calibration answer key, both model calibration response sets and both final per-criterion score sheets are published so a reader can recompute the checks. No substitution is permitted after any case output exists; a missing sheet leaves the report unscored.

speed_threshold.formula: For the three valid complete pairs, d_i=manual_seconds-agent_seconds and r_i=agent_seconds/manual_seconds; compute median(d_i) and median(r_i).
speed_threshold.material_if: All three pairs have valid completed outputs, median(d_i) is at least 30.0 seconds, and median(r_i) is at most 0.50. All conditions are conjunctive.

stopping_rule: Schedule exactly three frozen primary agent hires and three manual diagnoses, once each. Each primary ends in a schema-valid first accepted answer, timeout at 1,200 seconds, technical error or empty/malformed output. Stop only after all six primary attempts have terminal records. Secondary diagnostics never substitute.

successor_provenance.reason: The v3-05 official ledger remains separate and unchanged. As recorded there, manual primary v3-05-range-doctor::range-passing_gate_in_range-5223058::manual::primary terminated as interrupted with no recorded elapsed time, which fires v3-05's any_pair_is_incomplete check and leaves refuted as its only terminal state. That ledger is operator-held evidence outside the tracked tree at this registration: a reader who cannot see it should treat this motivation as unverified and judge this family on its own registered protocol instead. This is a distinct successor with a new archive-pinned frame, a new future pool-truth capture and a paid agent arm; it does not replace, retry or relabel that primary, and it does not relabel v3-05's published state.

timing.clock: The harness owns a monotonic_ns clock and serializes each read/check/append transaction for both arms; the resulting UTC event log remains an ordinary editable file.
timing.interruptions: The clock never pauses. Loading, reading, research, arithmetic, corrections, network waits and interruptions remain inside elapsed time; nothing is subtracted after the fact. Breaks occur only between cases.
timing.operator_control: The manual operator cannot start, stop, pause or edit the clock. The harness reveals the case and accepts one final submission through an API that refuses a replacement.
timing.start_event: Agent: immediately before the public request is sent. Manual: when the harness first reveals the frozen case tuple and source-access instructions.
timing.stop_event: Agent: after the complete response and receipt validate, or at terminal failure. Manual: when the first accepted final answer is submitted, or at terminal failure.
